equations.label: Lee 2021 Eq. (38) battery energy efficiency versus burning time
equations.quote: function of the final burning time by referring to the energy
equations.description: Battery energy efficiency as a logarithmic function of the final burning time, fitted to energy-efficiency measurements of one Li-polymer battery from the authors' previous study [1]; evaluated at the 600 s design burning time.
validity: fit used at t_b = 600 s in this paper; no stated range

claims.subject: LOX/RP-1 combustion chamber characteristic length
claims.object: 1.02-1.27 m; Lee uses 1.145 m from A-1 engine data
claims.statement: Lee 2021 states that a characteristic length of 1.02-1.27 m is generally recommended for LOX/RP-1 and sets 1.145 m from the A-1 engine data.
qualifiers: consistent with SP-125 Table 4-1 LO2/RP-1 40-50 in (1.016-1.27 m); cross-source agreement noted by reviewer
claims.quote: is recommended for the LOX/RP-1 propellant

claims.subject: Lee 2021 design point
claims.object: 500 N thrust, 20 bar chamber pressure, 30 km altitude, 600 s burning time
claims.statement: Lee 2021 analyses a 500 N, 20 bar, 30 km altitude, 600 s burning-time design point (Table 1); the 92.5% battery energy efficiency follows from Eq. 38 at this burn time.
claims.quote: the burning time was approximately 600 s as the operating conditions

claims.subject: Lee 2021 motor and battery data
claims.object: commercial products: Vishan EC2060L-3660 BLDC motor and Amicell ABLP8474170H320 Li-polymer cell
claims.statement: Lee 2021 takes motor and battery values from commercial products: the Vishan EC2060L-3660 BLDC motor (0.875 kW/kg, 57,940 rpm, 87%, 80 g) and the Amicell ABLP8474170H320 Li-polymer cell (325 W h/kg, 0.65 kW/kg, 222 g).
qualifiers: battery values are a single-cell specification

assumptions.statement: Lee et al. assume the electric-pump cycle is driven by a single motor, the commercial BLDC motor Vishan EC2060L-3660 (0.875 kW/kg, 57,940 rpm, 87%, 80 g).
assumptions.quote: it was assumed to be driven by a single motor
